title: All the more reason to
titleZh: 「All the more reason to …」表示「更有理由……」
titleEn: Using All the more reason to show stronger justification

source.file: Sentence Structure 159 -「All the more reason to …」表示「更有理由……」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Situation / fact. That is all the more reason to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Situation / fact. That is all the more reason to + base verb + other information
If + clause, that is all the more reason to + base verb
Situation / fact, which is all the more reason to + base verb
Situation / fact, which gives someone all the more reason to + base verb
That is all the more reason not to + base verb

example: If mistakes are costly, that is all the more reason to prepare well.
exampleZh: 如果犯錯的代價高昂，正因如此，我們更有理由做好準備。

examples.en: If mistakes are costly, that is all the more reason to prepare well.
examples.zh: 如果犯錯的代價高昂，正因如此，我們更有理由做好準備。
examples.highlight: If mistakes are costly, that is all the more reason to prepare well.

rules.zh: 這個句型表示「原本的情況令某個行動變得更有理由」 它通常用來說明： 某個問題並不是放棄的理由； 某個困難反而令準備、行動或小心處理變得更加必要； 前面的事實進一步加強後面的建議。 例如： （路程很長。正因如此，我們更有理由仔細規劃。） 路程很長並不是「不要出發」的理由，而是「更應仔細規劃」的理由。
rules.en: This pattern means that an existing situation gives even stronger justification for an action. It can show that a problem is not a reason to give up, that a difficulty makes preparation, action or caution more necessary, or that a preceding fact strengthens a recommendation. The journey is long. That is all the more reason to plan carefully means that the long journey is not a reason not to go; it is a stronger reason to plan carefully.
examples: The journey is long. That is all the more reason to plan carefully.

rules.zh: That 或 This 必須清楚指向前面的情況 That 和 This 通常指前一句提及的事實、問題、風險或困難。 這裏的 That 指「道路危險」這個事實。 不要在沒有清楚前文的情況下突然寫： 讀者必須知道 That 指甚麼。
rules.en: That or This must clearly refer to the preceding situation, normally a fact, problem, risk or difficulty. In The road is dangerous. That is all the more reason to drive slowly, That refers to the fact that the road is dangerous. Do not use That is all the more reason ... without clear preceding context; the reader must know what That means.
examples: The road is dangerous. That is all the more reason to drive slowly.

rules.zh: to 後面必須使用原形動詞 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Use the base form after to: all the more reason to prepare, to wait or to check, not to preparing, to prepared or to checks.
examples: all the more reason to prepare
all the more reason to wait
all the more reason to check
all the more reason to preparing
all the more reason to prepared
all the more reason to checks

rules.zh: 否定形式使用 not to （這些資料屬於私人資料。正因如此，更不應隨便分享。）
rules.en: Use not to for the negative form: all the more reason not to + base verb. For example: The information is private. That is all the more reason not to share it carelessly.
examples: all the more reason not to + base verb
The information is private. That is all the more reason not to share it carelessly.

rules.zh: 人物不清楚時，可以明確指出行動者 （學生需要更多支援，因此學校更有理由提供額外課堂。） 句中的 the school 清楚指出應該採取行動的一方。
rules.en: State the actor clearly when it would otherwise be unclear. In Students need more support. This gives the school all the more reason to provide extra classes, the school identifies the party that should act.

rules.zh: be 和 give 可以按照時態改變 現在： 過去：
rules.en: Change be and give to match the tense. Present forms include That is all the more reason to ... and This gives us all the more reason to .... Past forms include That was all the more reason to ... and This gave us all the more reason to ....
examples: That is all the more reason to...
This gives us all the more reason to...
That was all the more reason to...
This gave us all the more reason to...

rules.zh: 不要把普通結果誤寫成「更有理由」 這個句型必須表達「理由被加強」，而不只是普通的結果。 普通結果： （道路濕滑，所以汽車慢慢行駛。） 加強理由： （道路濕滑。正因如此，更有理由慢慢駕駛。） 與「All the more + adjective / adverb」的分別 reason 是名詞，後面接應該採取的行動。 它回答： （為甚麼更應該這樣做？） （風險很高。正因如此，更有理由仔細檢查一切。） 重點是：採取行動的理由變得更強。 這個結構直接加強形容詞或副詞的程度。 （這項任務很困難，但這反而令最後的成功更有意義。） 重點是：某種性質或程度變得更強。 核心分別 ＝ 更有理由採取某個行動 ＝ 某種性質或做事方式的程度更強 （任務很困難。正因如此，更有理由繼續。） （任務很困難，這令我們的成功更有意義。） 第一句說明「繼續下去的理由更強」。 第二句說明「成功變得更有意義」。
rules.en: Do not use this pattern for an ordinary result: it must express stronger justification. The road was wet, so the car moved slowly gives an ordinary result; The road was wet. That was all the more reason to drive slowly says the wet road strengthened the reason for careful action. Also distinguish all the more reason to + verb from all the more + adjective/adverb. Reason is a noun followed by the action that should be taken and answers “Why should someone do this?”; The risk is high. That is all the more reason to check everything carefully means that the reason for acting is stronger. All the more + adjective/adverb directly increases the degree of a quality or manner, as in The task was difficult, but that made the final success all the more meaningful. In short, all the more reason to + verb means there is stronger reason to act, whereas all the more + adjective/adverb means a quality or manner has a greater degree. The task was difficult. That is all the more reason to continue strengthens the reason to continue; The task was difficult, which made our success all the more meaningful strengthens the degree of meaningfulness.
examples: The road was wet, so the car moved slowly.
The road was wet. That was all the more reason to drive slowly.
A. All the more reason to + verb
Why should someone do this?
The risk is high. That is all the more reason to check everything carefully.
B. All the more + adjective / adverb
all the more meaningful
all the more important
all the more carefully
all the more surprising
The task was difficult, but that made the final success all the more meaningful.
All the more reason to + verb

benefits.zh: 這個句型能指出，問題、風險或弱點並不是放棄的理由，反而令準備或採取行動變得更加必要。
benefits.en: It turns a difficulty into a stronger reason for action This structure helps you explain that a problem, risk or weakness is not a reason to give up. Instead, it makes preparation or action even more necessary.
examples: Instead, it makes preparation or action even more necessary.

benefits.zh: 讀者可以立即看出前面的情況如何加強後面的建議，令推理更加清楚。
benefits.en: It makes your reasoning clear The reader can immediately understand the connection between the situation and your recommendation.

benefits.zh: 你不需要只說「你應該這樣做」，而可以先提出原因，再說明為甚麼這個行動特別有必要。 第二句更清楚強調：限期接近並不是等待的理由，而是立即開始的更強理由。
benefits.en: It makes advice sound more convincing Instead of simply saying “You should do this,” you can first provide a clear reason and then explain why the action is especially necessary. Compare: The deadline is close, so we should start now. The deadline is close. That is all the more reason to start now.
examples: The deadline is close, so we should start now.
The deadline is close. That is all the more reason to start now.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用於討論、作文、報告和工作溝通，特別適合回應反對意見、分析風險或加強建議。
benefits.en: It is useful in discussions, essays, reports and workplace communication, especially when responding to an objection, analysing a risk or strengthening a recommendation.

benefits.zh: 除了反覆使用 because、so 或 therefore，你也可以利用這個句型，把一個情況和應採取的行動連 接起來。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to connect ideas Instead of repeatedly using because, so or therefore, you can use this structure to connect a situation with an action.
